description: This file defines types, functions, and state management for handling active WebSocket listeners for WhatsApp within the openclaw project. It manages listener registration, retrieval, and context switching, specifically for WhatsApp Web integration.

methods.name: resolveWebAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID, defaulting to DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_ID if none provided.

methods.name: requireActiveWebListener
methods.description: Retrieves the active WebListener for a given account ID, throws an error if none is active.

methods.name: setActiveWebListener
methods.description: Sets or unsets the active WebListener for a specified account ID or the default account.

methods.name: getActiveWebListener
methods.description: Returns the current active WebListener for a given account ID, or null if none is active.
